request:
The production database connectors are the classes that directly subclass SQLDatabase (defined in auto_ontology/connectors/base.py), excluding any class defined in test code (every file under a tests/ folder counts as test code). For each such connector class, which public methods does the class define in its own body that SQLDatabase itself does not define? A method is public when its name does not start with an underscore (so __init__ and other dunder methods are excluded); anything written with def directly in the class body counts as a method, including properties and context-manager methods. Methods inherited without being redefined do not count. Return one row per (connector class symbol ID, method name).

Requested output columns: class_symbol_id (string), method_name (string).
explanation: Finds the SQLDatabase class, then all classes that directly subclass it via class_bases, excluding classes in test files. For each connector class, it lists methods defined directly in the class body (using symbol_profile's enclosing_class_symbol_id) whose names don't start with an underscore and that SQLDatabase does not itself define.
sql: WITH sql_db AS (SELECT s.symbol_id FROM code.symbols s WHERE s.name = 'SQLDatabase' AND s.kind = 'class'), connectors AS (SELECT DISTINCT cb.class_symbol_id FROM code.class_bases cb JOIN sql_db d ON cb.base_symbol_id = d.symbol_id JOIN code.symbols cs ON cs.symbol_id = cb.class_symbol_id JOIN code.files f ON f.file_id = cs.file_id WHERE NOT f.is_test AND NOT (f.file_id LIKE '%/tests/%' OR f.file_id LIKE 'tests/%')), sql_methods AS (SELECT sp.name FROM code.symbol_profile sp JOIN sql_db d ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = d.symbol_id WHERE sp.kind = 'method') SELECT DISTINCT c.class_symbol_id, sp.name AS method_name FROM connectors c JOIN code.symbol_profile sp ON sp.enclosing_class_symbol_id = c.class_symbol_id WHERE sp.kind = 'method' AND sp.name NOT LIKE '\_%' ESCAPE '\' AND sp.name NOT IN (SELECT name FROM sql_methods) ORDER BY c.class_symbol_id, sp.name
